answer: Proposed: walnut irrigation agents forecast water use from tide-driven salinity and solar zenith angle. Each key locks at least 10 tokens for 24 hours. Validators check disjoint escrows and score timely forecasts against signed meter logs; failed checks mean no pay. A fixed 100-token daily pool is split by stake times accuracy, not key count. Stake returns; liquidity is tied up, hardware is reusable, power costs recur. Rich owners can dominate; corrupt meters defeat scoring. Ten parallel 10-token keys making identical forecasts lock 100 tokens and earn the same as one 100-token key.
